result.summary: The image depicts a wide urban street with a continuous sidewalk and commercial/residential buildings at the street edge. The environment is vehicle-oriented, characterized by a wide roadway with minimal pedestrian infrastructure beyond the basic walkway.

result.summary: The street features a wide roadway with multiple lanes, including a dedicated bus lane, and mixed-use buildings directly fronting the sidewalk. While basic infrastructure like signalized intersections and marked crosswalks are present, the lack of physical buffers and long crossing distances are notable.

hazards.description: The wide roadway requires pedestrians to spend more time exposed to traffic while crossing.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval
interventions.description: Adjust signal timing to give pedestrians a head start before vehicles get a green light.

result.summary: The image shows a wide urban sidewalk fronting mixed-use row buildings with ground-floor commercial spaces. While the walkway provides ample space for pedestrians, the pavement is uneven in several sections and there is no physical buffer or street furniture separating the walking area from the adjacent roadway.

hazards.name: Uneven Pavement
hazards.description: Cracked and misaligned concrete slabs on the sidewalk create significant tripping hazards for pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the foreground and middle ground of the sidewalk area.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Buffer
hazards.description: There is no physical separation (trees, planters, or parked cars) between the wide sidewalk and the active travel lanes.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curb line separating the sidewalk from the asphalt roadway.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Rehabilitation
interventions.description: Repair and level the concrete sidewalk slabs to provide a smooth, ADA-compliant walking surface.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planters
interventions.description: Install street trees or large planters along the curb to create a protective buffer for pedestrians and improve the streetscape environment.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Add street lighting to improve visibility and safety for pedestrians during evening hours.
